meta.description: Master Control Inventory — Required At All Times — System-Ready Data Model
meta.generated_note: AUTO-GENERATED via 'npm run controls:generate' — DO NOT EDIT COPIES DIRECTLY. Single canonical source: public/MASTER_CONTROL_INVENTORY_DATA_MODEL.json

controls.control_name: Patient Rights Notice & Admission Consent Program
controls.description: Standing capability to deliver Patient Rights Notice, Admission Consent, HIPAA NPP, and Advance Directive information at or before first visit to every admitted patient.
controls.evidence_required: Signed CL-FM-001/002/003 per patient; NPP log
controls.trigger_condition: Any active patient record missing signed Patient Rights notice, Admission Consent, or NPP delivery confirmation; OR >0% gap in NPP log vs admission count

controls.description: Continuously available qualified interpreter and translated-materials capability for LEP patients across all service hours.
controls.evidence_required: Vendor contract, interpreter utilization log, translated NPP/consent stock
controls.trigger_condition: Interpreter vendor contract expired or terminated; OR LEP patient admitted without documented interpreter arrangement; OR translated materials (NPP/consent) not on file in required languages

controls.description: Always-on intake channel (phone, written, verbal) for patient complaints with logging and acknowledgement.
controls.trigger_condition: Grievance log inactive >30 days without documented zero-complaint attestation; OR any complaint without acknowledgement letter within required window; OR intake contact number non-functional

controls.description: Posted/provided notice of state HH hotline and patient rights contact info on all admissions.
controls.trigger_condition: Hotline notice missing from current admission packet version; OR notice phone number outdated; OR physical posting removed or defaced

controls.description: Continuously operational process to receive, verify, route, and fulfill access/amendment/deletion requests within statutory windows.
controls.failure_risk: Private right of action; HIPAA CMP
controls.trigger_condition: Any open request past 30-day HIPAA window or 45-day CCPA window without fulfillment or documented extension; OR no intake mechanism active

controls.description: Standing program offering good-faith estimates, financial counseling, and charity-care determinations to any patient at admission or on request.
controls.trigger_condition: Any new admission without signed FN-FM-004 on file; OR charity care program policy expired; OR no financial counselor available for >3 business days

controls.description: Continuous 24/7/365 licensed-clinician availability for patient calls, with logging, triage, and next-business-day reconciliation.
controls.evidence_required: On-call schedule, OP-FM-010 call log, CM daily review
controls.trigger_condition: On-call schedule gap (unassigned shift); OR OP-FM-010 log not completed by next business day; OR call not answered/returned within policy SLA; OR no licensed clinician designated

controls.description: Standing capability to complete, QA, lock, and transmit OASIS within 30 days; correct and retransmit as required.
controls.trigger_condition: Any OASIS assessment not transmitted within 30 days of completion; OR transmission rejection rate >0 without correction; OR OASIS-qualified staff ratio insufficient to cover active census

controls.description: Continuously operational intake, routing, authentication, and tracking of physician orders; verbal orders same-day, signature within agency SLA.
controls.evidence_required: Order audit log, signed orders file
controls.trigger_condition: Any verbal order not documented same-day; OR written order unsigned >30 days; OR order tracking log gap; OR physician contact information not current

controls.control_name: Plan of Care (CMS-485) Establishment & 60-Day Review Program
controls.description: Program ensuring every patient has an active, physician-signed POC and recert/review at least every 60 days.
controls.trigger_condition: Any active patient without a current physician-signed CMS-485; OR recertification overdue by >1 day; OR unsigned 485 in chart >30 days

controls.description: Standing requirement for clinician-to-clinician/physician communication within 24h of visit and documented interdisciplinary coordination.
controls.trigger_condition: Visit note without same-day or next-day communication documentation; OR MDT conference gap >60 days for complex patients; OR care plan change not communicated to physician within 24h

controls.description: Continuous supervision cadence: RN supervisory visit every 14 days; direct on-site observation every 60 days; annual re-competency.
controls.trigger_condition: Any HHA with active patients and supervisory visit overdue >14 days; OR direct observation overdue >60 days; OR annual re-competency not completed; OR HHA assigned without initial competency on file

controls.description: Ongoing initial + annual competency validation for RN, LVN/LPN, PT/PTA, OT/COTA, SLP, MSW, HHA, plus OASIS-specific.
controls.trigger_condition: Any clinician with annual competency overdue >0 days; OR new clinician practicing before initial competency sign-off; OR OASIS validation missing for OASIS-collecting staff

controls.description: Continuous MAR maintenance; medication reconciliation at SOC/ROC/Recert; always-available med review capability.
controls.trigger_condition: Active patient without current MAR; OR medication reconciliation not completed at SOC, ROC, or Recertification; OR high-alert medication without documented oversight; OR MAR update lag >24h

controls.description: Agency-wide, always-active infection prevention program with standard precautions on every visit, line list surveillance, outbreak protocol.
controls.evidence_required: CL-FM-021, QA-FM-006 line list, outbreak SOP
controls.trigger_condition: IP role vacant without interim designation; OR infection line list not updated within 30 days; OR PPE supply confirmed depleted without reorder; OR outbreak protocol document not current-year version

controls.description: Continuous capability to flag and manage high-risk patients (fall, wound, sepsis, rehospitalization risk) per protocol.
controls.trigger_condition: High-risk patient without active monitoring flag in EHR; OR CL-FM-047 protocol not initiated within 24h of risk identification; OR dashboard high-risk count discrepancy vs census

controls.description: Continuous process to log and clinically justify any missed visit the day it occurs.
controls.trigger_condition: Scheduled visit not completed and CL-FM-011 not logged same day; OR missed visit count rising without clinical justification; OR LUPA threshold breach without documentation

controls.description: Always-maintained clinical record system supporting integrity, retrievability, and statutory retention (≥5 yrs federal; 7 yrs CA).
controls.trigger_condition: Record request unfulfillable within 24h; OR backup failure affecting clinical records; OR retention schedule not Board-approved current year; OR record destruction without authorization

controls.description: Continuously maintained all-hazards EPP: plan, policies, communication plan, training, and exercises per CMS EP rule.
controls.trigger_condition: EP plan not reviewed/updated within biennial cycle; OR EP Coordinator role vacant without designee; OR communication plan contacts not verified within 12 months; OR annual exercise not completed

controls.description: Continuously maintained, annually re-reviewed HVA used to scope EP plan.
controls.trigger_condition: HVA document older than 12 months without annual reaffirmation; OR material local hazard change not reflected in HVA

controls.description: Continuously updated cross-domain risk register with quarterly consolidation.
controls.trigger_condition: Risk register not updated for >30 days; OR quarterly review missed; OR high-severity risk open >90 days without mitigation plan

controls.description: Always-on written WVP program with violent-incident log, annual review, hazard assessments.
controls.trigger_condition: Violent incident not logged within 24h; OR WVP plan not reviewed within 12 months; OR workplace hazard assessment overdue; OR SB 553 training not completed by all staff

controls.description: Written IIPP continuously maintained with hazard identification, correction, training, recordkeeping.
controls.trigger_condition: IIPP document not updated within required review cycle; OR identified hazard not corrected within required timeframe; OR IIPP training records gap

controls.description: Continuous maintenance of OSHA 300 Log; annual 300A post Feb 1–Apr 30.
controls.trigger_condition: Recordable injury not logged within 7 days; OR 300A not posted Feb 1–Apr 30; OR log retention < 5 years; OR log missing establishment name/address fields

controls.description: Continuously maintained ECP with PPE availability, training, and post-exposure procedures.
controls.trigger_condition: ECP not reviewed within 12 months; OR BBP training not completed by all field staff; OR PPE stock below minimum threshold; OR post-exposure procedure not documented within required timeframe

controls.description: Always-on intake, logging, triage, and RCA-routing for patient, staff, and operational incidents.
controls.trigger_condition: Incident reported without same-day logging; OR RCA not initiated within 30 days of adverse event; OR intake mechanism (reporting line/portal) non-functional; OR adverse event log shows gap

controls.description: Continuous capability to detect, report, and escalate suspected abuse/neglect to authorities per statute.
controls.trigger_condition: Suspected abuse/neglect not reported to APS/CPS/law enforcement within required statutory window; OR staff without current mandatory reporter training; OR CL-FM-030 not completed for any suspected incident

controls.description: Continuously maintained pandemic/outbreak plan and activation readiness.
controls.evidence_required: RM-FM-006 Pandemic Plan Readiness Checklist, activation SOP
controls.trigger_condition: Pandemic plan not updated within 24 months; OR activation criteria not defined; OR supply chain contacts (PPE/testing) not verified within 12 months

controls.regulatory_basis: OIG CPG for Home Health; § 6032 DRA
controls.description: Continuously operating compliance program with written standards, Compliance Officer, Committee, training, communication, monitoring, enforcement, and response.
controls.evidence_required: Program charter, Committee minutes (CO-FM-024), annual work plan
controls.trigger_condition: Compliance Officer role vacant >30 days; OR annual work plan not approved; OR compliance committee not convened in >60 days; OR any of 7 OIG elements documentably absent

controls.description: Named, qualified Compliance Officer in place at all times with direct Board access.
controls.trigger_condition: Named Compliance Officer departed without replacement appointment; OR CO role filled by person with disqualifying conflict; OR CO lacks direct Board access per bylaws

controls.description: Code of Conduct issued to all workforce members at onboarding and annually acknowledged.
controls.trigger_condition: Any active employee without current-year Code of Conduct acknowledgment; OR acknowledgment rate <100% at annual deadline; OR CoC not updated within 24 months

controls.description: 24/7 anonymous reporting channel with documented non-retaliation policy.
controls.trigger_condition: Hotline number non-functional; OR hotline log not reviewed within 30 days; OR report received without documented investigation initiation within 5 business days; OR non-retaliation policy not posted

controls.description: Monthly screening of all employees, contractors, vendors, BOD against OIG-LEIE, SAM, and state exclusion lists.
controls.evidence_required: HR-FM-005 monthly screening log, monthly attestation

forms_logs: HR-FM-005 OIG/SAM Monthly Exclusion Verification Log

controls.trigger_condition: Monthly screening cycle missed or >35 days since last run; OR roster used for screening does not match current active roster; OR confirmed match not suspended within 24h

controls.description: Continuous tracking of referral-source, vendor, and physician relationships against AKS/Stark.
controls.trigger_condition: New physician or referral-source relationship without FMV analysis on file; OR existing relationship FMV not refreshed within 12 months; OR gift/entertainment above threshold not disclosed

controls.description: Ongoing fraud/waste/abuse training and claim-risk monitoring.
controls.trigger_condition: FWA training completion rate <100% at annual deadline; OR new hire not trained within 30 days; OR monthly monitoring report not produced; OR denial rate spike not triggering FWA review

controls.description: Continuously executed annual risk-based internal audit plan with monthly pre/post-bill sampling.
controls.evidence_required: CO-FM-018 work plan, monthly audit reports

forms_logs: CO-FM-018 Annual Auditing & Monitoring Work Plan

controls.trigger_condition: Work plan not Board-approved at fiscal year start; OR monthly audit sampling not completed; OR audit findings not tracked to closure; OR error rate >5% without CAP

controls.description: Continuous monitoring of CMS/OIG/OCR/CDPH/DIR changes with impact analysis and policy updates.
controls.trigger_condition: Scan log not updated for >7 days; OR regulatory change effective date passed without policy update completed; OR impact analysis overdue >10 business days

controls.description: Continuously maintained Privacy Policies, Privacy Officer, NPP, minimum-necessary, authorizations.
controls.trigger_condition: Privacy Officer role vacant; OR NPP not current with regulatory changes; OR authorization log gap; OR minimum-necessary policy not enforced in EHR access controls

controls.description: Continuously enforced Administrative, Physical, and Technical Safeguards per Security Rule.
controls.evidence_required: Policies, configurations, current SRA, audit logs
controls.trigger_condition: SRA older than 12 months without annual reaffirmation; OR any required implementation spec (admin/physical/technical) without written policy; OR policy not reviewed in 12+ months

controls.control_name: Designated HIPAA Privacy Officer & Security Officer
controls.description: Named Privacy Officer and Security Officer in place at all times (may be combined role in small agency).
controls.trigger_condition: Either named officer departed without replacement; OR combined role taken on by person with no HIPAA training; OR appointment not documented in Board minutes

controls.description: Continuous capability to assess, investigate, and notify on suspected HIPAA/CMIA breaches within statutory windows.
controls.evidence_required: CO-FM-029 breach risk assessments, notification templates
controls.trigger_condition: Suspected breach without risk assessment initiated within 5 business days; OR breach confirmed and 60-day OCR notification window tracked; OR notification templates outdated

controls.description: Continuously current BAA inventory for every vendor with PHI access; annual refresh.
controls.trigger_condition: Any BA accessing PHI without current executed BAA; OR BAA expiration date passed; OR new vendor onboarded without BAA executed before data flow

controls.description: Continuous self-verification that every HHA CoP is met; evidence maintained and surveyor-ready.
controls.trigger_condition: Self-assessment not completed within 12 months; OR any CoP element flagged as non-compliant without open CAP; OR surveyor-readiness package not current

controls.description: Continuously operating annual + new-hire compliance training curriculum with completion tracking.
controls.trigger_condition: Any active employee with overdue mandatory module in LMS; OR new hire not trained within 30 days; OR training content not updated to reflect current regulations; OR completion rate <100% at annual deadline

controls.description: Legally constituted Governing Body with documented authority for agency operations at all times.
controls.trigger_condition: Quorum lost and not restored within 90 days; OR board meeting missed >90-day cadence; OR GB member with undisclosed conflict; OR bylaws not reviewed within 3 years

controls.description: Qualified Administrator in place at all times; Designee named for any absence; replacement within 30 days of vacancy.
controls.trigger_condition: Administrator position vacant >30 days without Board-approved interim; OR absence without named designee; OR designee does not meet § 484.115 qualifications

controls.description: Qualified Clinical Manager designated at all times with Clinical Designee for absence coverage.
controls.trigger_condition: Clinical Manager vacancy without Board-approved interim designation; OR designee not meeting § 484.115 RN qualifications; OR absence without documented coverage

controls.description: Current, approved org chart reflecting actual reporting and delegation.
controls.trigger_condition: Org chart not updated within 90 days of role change; OR roles listed do not match actual active designees; OR not Board-approved current year

controls.regulatory_basis: State HHA licensure; Medicare § 424; state Medicaid
controls.description: Continuously maintained register of all agency-level licenses/certifications with expiration tracking (90/60/30-day alerts).

forms_logs: GV-FM-019 Agency Licensure & Certification Tracking Log

controls.trigger_condition: Any agency-level license at <30-day expiration without renewal confirmation; OR expired license with active billing; OR CDPH/Medicare certification lapse

controls.description: Current, approved written policy defining accepted geography, payer mix, diagnoses, and service scope.
controls.trigger_condition: Scope-of-service change (new payer, new geography, new service line) not reflected in policy within 30 days; OR policy not reviewed/approved within 12 months

controls.description: Current Board-approved institutional plan and operating budget in place for each fiscal year.

forms_logs: GV-FM-005 Board Minutes with budget approval vote

controls.trigger_condition: Fiscal year started without Board-approved budget; OR budget variance >10% without approved amendment; OR institutional plan not aligned with current year budget

controls.description: Continuously enforced COI program with onboarding + annual disclosures for Board, officers, and key staff.
controls.evidence_required: Signed COI disclosure forms, COI log

forms_logs: COI Disclosure Forms (all Board members + key staff)

controls.trigger_condition: Any Board member or officer without current-year COI disclosure; OR undisclosed conflict discovered; OR new key relationship not timely reported

controls.description: Current written delegation matrix showing who signs what, including Administrator/Clinical Manager absence coverage.
controls.trigger_condition: DOA matrix not reviewed within 12 months; OR role change not reflected within 30 days; OR delegation invoked without documented authority

controls.description: Publicly available, current information about services, hours, and contacts; updated within 30 days of scope change.
controls.trigger_condition: Scope change not reflected in public materials within 30 days; OR contact number/address inaccurate; OR website not accessible

controls.description: Continuous log of stakeholder grievances escalated to governance for tracking and closure.
controls.trigger_condition: Escalated grievance not logged within 48h; OR open grievance without resolution plan >30 days; OR log not reviewed at Board meeting

controls.description: Continuously maintained personnel file for every worker: I-9, screenings, licenses, training, acknowledgments, evaluations.

forms_logs: HR-FM-015 Personnel File Content Audit Checklist

controls.trigger_condition: Any active employee with missing I-9, expired license, or overdue training in personnel file; OR personnel file audit showing >0 incomplete files; OR I-9 re-verification overdue for non-citizens

controls.description: Continuous register of all licensed staff with PSV at hire and prior to every renewal; same-day suspension on lapse.
controls.trigger_condition: License expiring within 30 days without renewal confirmation; OR lapsed license without same-day suspension; OR PSV record >12 months old for active staff; OR clinician practicing on expired license

controls.description: Current approved job descriptions for every regulated role; signed at hire and material change.
controls.trigger_condition: Active role without current Board-approved JD; OR JD not updated after material role change; OR employee without signed JD acknowledgment on file

controls.description: Continuously operating training program ensuring every HHA receives ≥12 hrs in-service per 12-month period.
controls.trigger_condition: Any HHA with <12 hours logged before 12-month anniversary; OR training content not updated within 24 months; OR HHA assigned to patients while in-service deficit exists

controls.control_name: Skilled Professional Supervision Program (RN→LPN, PT→PTA, OT→COTA)
controls.description: Continuous supervision of assistant-level disciplines per state law.
controls.evidence_required: HR-FM-021 RN/LPN supervision log, HR-FM-022 therapist assistant log

forms_logs: HR-FM-021 RN Oversight of LPN/LVN Log

controls.trigger_condition: LPN/PTA/COTA visit without supervising RN/PT/OT documentation per state cadence; OR supervision log gap >state-required interval; OR supervisor license lapsed

controls.control_name: Wage & Hour Compliance Program (Timekeeping, Meal/Rest, OT)
controls.regulatory_basis: FLSA; CA Labor Code §§ 226, 510, 512; Wage Orders
controls.description: Continuous timekeeping, meal/rest attestation, overtime approval, itemized wage statements.
controls.trigger_condition: Meal/rest attestation missing >5% of shifts; OR overtime paid without approval documentation; OR itemized wage statement deficient per Labor Code § 226; OR payroll cycle late

controls.description: Continuously enforced EEO policies, complaint intake, and mandated harassment prevention training.
controls.trigger_condition: Supervisor without biennial AB 1825 training; OR non-supervisory employee without SB 1343 training by deadline; OR complaint intake mechanism not functioning; OR EEO policy not posted

controls.description: Continuous application of ABC test + IRS factors to every engagement; annual reviews.
controls.trigger_condition: Any 1099 engagement without HR-FM-059 determination on file; OR annual review overdue; OR reclassification signal (same-work, control indicators) not acted upon

controls.description: Continuously maintained WC insurance and employer reporting machinery (DWC-1, 5020, OSHA 300).
controls.trigger_condition: WC insurance policy expired or lapsed; OR DWC-1 not provided to injured employee within 1 business day; OR OSHA 300 not current; OR claim not filed with carrier within 5 days

controls.description: Standing requirement for pre-start and ongoing health clearance per role.
controls.trigger_condition: Any clinician practicing without current TB clearance; OR health clearance record missing from personnel file; OR immunization requirement added by public health order without agency update

controls.description: Continuously maintained inventory of all ePHI-containing systems, devices, and data flows.
controls.failure_risk: Foundational HIPAA failure — SRA invalid without current inventory
controls.trigger_condition: New system deployed or vendor added without IT-FM-001 update; OR inventory not reconciled for >30 days; OR ePHI data flow documented inaccurately

controls.control_name: Annual Security Risk Analysis & Risk Management Plan
controls.description: Current SRA on file at all times with active remediation register.
controls.evidence_required: IT-FM-002 SRA report, IT-FM-003 remediation register

forms_logs: IT-FM-003 Risk Management Plan & Remediation Register

controls.trigger_condition: SRA completion date >12 months ago; OR material system change without SRA update; OR critical risk in remediation register open >90 days; OR Board not briefed on SRA results

controls.description: Continuously enforced RBAC with role matrix, provisioning, and quarterly reviews.
controls.evidence_required: IT-FM-005 RBAC matrix; IT-FM-014 quarterly review reports
controls.trigger_condition: Quarterly access review overdue; OR user with privileges exceeding role matrix; OR provisioning without IT-FM-004 request on file; OR manager attestation completion <100%

controls.description: Continuous capability to disable all access effective separation date (same-day for involuntary).
controls.trigger_condition: Active account found post-separation date; OR involuntary separation access not disabled same-day; OR quarterly HR-IT reconciliation shows active-account / inactive-roster discrepancy

controls.description: Continuous enforcement of MFA on all remote, admin, and EHR access.
controls.trigger_condition: Any user with remote or admin access not enrolled in MFA; OR MFA bypass exception active without Security Officer approval; OR enrollment rate <100% for EHR users

controls.control_name: Audit Logging & Information System Activity Review
controls.description: Continuous logging of all ePHI systems, centralized SIEM, monthly activity review, 6-year retention.
controls.evidence_required: IT-FM-020 logging inventory, IT-FM-022 monthly reviews

forms_logs: IT-FM-022 Monthly Information System Activity Review

controls.trigger_condition: Any ePHI system with logging disabled or not reporting to SIEM; OR monthly activity review not completed; OR log retention <6 years; OR alert rule gaps for after-hours ePHI access

controls.description: Continuous enforcement of encryption for ePHI on endpoints, backups, email, and transmissions.
controls.failure_risk: Lost device = presumed HIPAA breach; transmission violation
controls.trigger_condition: Any device with ePHI not enrolled in MDM full-disk encryption; OR unencrypted backup detected; OR email ePHI transmitted without TLS/portal encryption; OR encryption register not updated >30 days

controls.description: Continuous encrypted backups with offsite/cloud copy; annual verified restore test.
controls.evidence_required: IT-FM-023 backup log, IT-FM-025 annual restore test report
controls.trigger_condition: Backup job failed and not remediated within 24h; OR annual restore test not completed; OR offsite/cloud copy not verified within 30 days; OR backup log gap

controls.description: Continuously maintained DR/BC plan aligned with EP program; annual exercise.
controls.evidence_required: IT-FM-026 BIA, IT-FM-027 DR/BC plan, IT-FM-028 exercise report
controls.trigger_condition: DR/BC plan not reviewed within 12 months; OR annual tabletop exercise not completed; OR RTO/RPO not validated; OR plan not integrated with clinical EP workflow

controls.description: Always-on IR capability with documented plan, severity matrix, and containment SLAs (S1 ≤1h).
controls.trigger_condition: IR plan not tested within 12 months; OR S1 incident not contained within 1h SLA; OR SIEM alert not actioned; OR post-incident CAP not completed within 30 days

controls.description: Continuous endpoint management: full-disk encryption, EDR/AV, MDM enrollment, patching per SLA.
controls.evidence_required: MDM console enrollment report, IT-FM-024 encryption register
controls.trigger_condition: Any agency device not enrolled in MDM; OR AV/EDR not active on >0% of enrolled devices; OR patch compliance <95% for critical patches within SLA; OR lost device not remote-wiped within 1h

controls.description: Continuous vulnerability scanning and patching per severity SLA (critical ≤7d, high ≤30d).
controls.evidence_required: IT-FM-035 vulnerability scan reports, patch evidence
controls.trigger_condition: Monthly scan not completed; OR critical vulnerability on ePHI system unpatched >7 days; OR high vulnerability unpatched >30 days; OR exception approved without compensating control

controls.description: Continuously maintained email gateway with SPF/DKIM/DMARC, TLS, DLP for ePHI.
controls.trigger_condition: DMARC policy disabled; OR ePHI sent unencrypted via email; OR DLP policy bypass detected; OR phishing simulation score >20% failure rate without remediation

controls.description: DLP-enforced default block of removable media; tracked exceptions only.
controls.evidence_required: DLP config evidence, IT-FM-034 exception log
controls.trigger_condition: DLP USB block policy disabled; OR exception used without IT-FM-034 on file; OR USB media not sanitized post-use

controls.description: Continuous sanitization per NIST 800-88 before retirement; paper PHI shredding log.
controls.trigger_condition: Device retired without IT-FM-036 on file; OR paper PHI shredding log gap >7 days; OR vendor CoD missing for any destroyed media; OR device found in trash/e-waste without sanitization

controls.description: Continuous badge access, visitor logs, restricted zones (server, records), camera coverage.
controls.evidence_required: IT-FM-045 badge log, IT-FM-046 visitor log
controls.trigger_condition: Visitor log not maintained continuously; OR server/records room physically unsecured; OR badge not revoked on separation same-day; OR camera coverage gap in restricted zones

controls.description: Continuous VPN/ZTNA with MFA and device-posture enforcement; session logging.
controls.trigger_condition: Remote access session without MFA; OR unmanaged device bypassing posture check; OR session logs not reviewed in monthly IT-WF-06 activity review; OR VPN access active post-separation

controls.description: Continuous change management with pre-approval, test, rollback, and retrospective.
controls.trigger_condition: Change deployed to ePHI system without CAB approval; OR emergency change without retrospective completed; OR change without documented rollback plan; OR failed change without PIR

controls.description: Continuous vendor security review, SOC2/HITRUST validation, annual re-review for all PHI/critical vendors.
controls.evidence_required: IT-FM-040/041 vendor security files; current BAA register
controls.trigger_condition: Any PHI-touching vendor with annual security review overdue; OR SOC2 report expired >12 months; OR vendor breach notification received without CO-WF-10 triggered; OR new cloud SaaS deployed without pre-approval

controls.control_name: PPS Claims Submission System (NOA ≤5 Days / Final Claim)
controls.description: Continuously operational claims pipeline: eligibility verification, NOA ≤5 days of SOC, pre-bill audit, final claim.

forms_logs: FN-FM-012 Late NOA Penalty Tracking Log

controls.trigger_condition: Any SOC without NOA submitted within 5 calendar days; OR final claim submitted without completed FN-FM-010 pre-bill checklist; OR RA not reconciled within 5 business days of receipt

controls.control_name: Pre-Billing Audit Control (F2F / POC / OASIS Lock)
controls.description: Continuous pre-billing verification: F2F, signed POC, locked OASIS in place before any final claim.
controls.trigger_condition: Final claim submitted without all three: F2F on file, signed CMS-485, and locked OASIS; OR pre-bill checklist not completed; OR coder bypass of required validation step

controls.description: Continuous pre-bill and post-bill coding/documentation sampling feeding denial mgmt and overpayment workflow.
controls.evidence_required: CO-FM-018 audit plan, monthly audit reports

forms_logs: CO-FM-018 Annual Auditing & Monitoring Work Plan

controls.trigger_condition: Monthly sampling not completed; OR audit plan not approved at FY start; OR error rate >5% without CAP initiated; OR overpayment identified without FN-WF-08 triggered

controls.description: Always-on mechanism to identify, quantify, and return overpayments within 60 days of identification.
controls.trigger_condition: Overpayment identified and 60-day clock not tracked in system; OR refund not submitted by day 60; OR audit finding triggering potential overpayment without investigation opened; OR self-disclosure evaluation not documented

controls.description: Continuous AR monitoring with quarterly CMS-838 filing (even if zero credit balances).
controls.evidence_required: FN-FM-018 quarterly credit balance report, filed CMS-838
controls.trigger_condition: CMS-838 not filed within 30 days of quarter end; OR credit balance >90 days without refund/resolution; OR AR report not reconciled to identify Medicare credits

controls.description: Continuous denial logging, root cause analysis, and appeals within statutory windows (Levels 1–5).
controls.evidence_required: FN-FM-013/014/015 denial log, RCA, appeal records
controls.trigger_condition: Denial logged without RCA initiated within 14 days; OR Level 1 appeal not filed within 120 days; OR denial rate >5% without QAPI PIP triggered; OR appeal status not tracked in FN-FM-015

controls.description: Standing capability to respond to MAC/UPIC/RAC ADRs within required timeframes with complete record packages.
controls.evidence_required: FN-FM-016 ADR tracking log, FN-FM-017 review checklist
controls.trigger_condition: ADR received without FN-FM-016 logged same-day; OR response not submitted within 45 days (or per ADR deadline); OR record package missing physician signatures or OASIS confirmation

controls.control_name: Accounts Payable Vendor-Exclusion Check at Payment
controls.description: Continuous verification that every vendor payee is on approved list and not OIG/SAM excluded at payment.
controls.evidence_required: OP-FM-005 approved vendor list, HR-FM-005 screening evidence at payment
controls.trigger_condition: Payment processed to vendor not on approved list; OR vendor OIG/SAM screen overdue at payment date; OR new vendor payment without pre-payment exclusion check documentation

controls.description: Continuously maintained cost-report-grade financial records and reconciliations supporting annual 1728-20 filing.
controls.evidence_required: GL, trial balance, PBC files, cost report working papers
controls.trigger_condition: Monthly close not completed within 10 business days; OR cost report not filed within 5 months of FYE; OR GL reconciliation gap; OR MAC correspondence unanswered past deadline

controls.description: Continuously operational payroll with accurate time, OT, deductions, and federal/state tax filings.
controls.evidence_required: Payroll registers, tax filings (941, DE-9, W-2)
controls.trigger_condition: Payroll cycle missed or delayed; OR 941 not filed by IRS deadline; OR W-2 not issued by Jan 31; OR payroll error not corrected in next cycle; OR itemized wage statement deficient per § 226

controls.description: Continuously current, authoritative register of every P&P with metadata, owner, tier, version, and next-review date.
controls.evidence_required: EN-FM-002 Master Policy Index / Taxonomy Register
controls.trigger_condition: Register not updated within 24h of lifecycle event; OR monthly reconciliation not completed; OR policies in portal without corresponding register entry; OR overdue policies >30 days without owner notification

controls.description: Continuously operating policy lifecycle with approvals, version control, and retirement.
controls.trigger_condition: Policy published without required tier-appropriate approval; OR outdated version accessible in portal without retired flag; OR policy without named owner; OR review cycle overdue >30 days

controls.description: All workforce, contractors, and BAs acknowledge relevant policies at hire, material update, and annually.
controls.evidence_required: EN-FM-001 signed acknowledgments, EN-FM-012 completion report
controls.trigger_condition: Any active staff with overdue acknowledgment at annual deadline; OR material policy update without triggered re-acknowledgment in LMS; OR new hire without Day 1 acknowledgment on file

controls.description: Continuously enforced retention schedule across clinical, HR, financial, HIPAA records with authorized destruction.
controls.evidence_required: Retention schedule document, destruction authorization logs
controls.trigger_condition: Retention schedule not Board-reviewed within 12 months; OR record destroyed without authorization; OR record category missing from schedule; OR electronic record purged before minimum retention period

controls.description: Continuously maintained calendar of all mandatory recurring events with assigned owners and status tracking.
controls.trigger_condition: Calendar not updated within 30 days of regulatory change; OR any mandatory event overdue without CAP; OR event owner not assigned for upcoming required deadline

controls.description: Continuously updated enterprise compliance/quality KPI reporting to leadership and Board.
controls.evidence_required: Monthly dashboards, quarterly Board reporting pack

forms_logs: GV-FM-023 Annual Compliance Report to Governing Body

controls.trigger_condition: Monthly dashboard not released by day 15; OR KPI missing a required domain; OR Board not briefed within 90 days; OR control showing RED without escalation initiated

controls.description: Effective, ongoing, agency-wide, data-driven QAPI program with continuous data collection, trending, PIPs, and Board oversight.
controls.evidence_required: QAPI charter, dashboards, PIP files, committee + Board minutes
controls.trigger_condition: QAPI charter not Board-approved current year; OR committee meeting gap >90 days; OR no active PIP documented; OR monthly dashboard not produced for >1 month; OR Board not reviewing QAPI quarterly

controls.description: At all times, at least one Performance Improvement Project is active with documented charter, baseline, and remeasurement.
controls.evidence_required: QA-FM-002 PIP charter, active remeasurement data
controls.trigger_condition: Zero active PIPs at any point in the calendar year; OR PIP charter missing baseline/target/team; OR remeasurement data gap >90 days; OR PIP closed without sustainment plan

controls.description: Always-on monthly dashboard combining OASIS, claims, HHCAHPS, infection, and adverse event data.
controls.failure_risk: § 484.65 deficiency — no data-driven evidence of monitoring

forms_logs: Source data: CL-FM-045 OASIS log, claims data, QA-FM-006 infection log, QA-FM-004 adverse event log

controls.trigger_condition: Dashboard not released by day 15 of the month; OR >1 data source missing from dashboard; OR 12-month archive incomplete; OR variance threshold breached without escalation note

controls.description: Continuous HHCAHPS vendor submission OR current CMS Participation Exemption Request (PER) on file.
controls.evidence_required: Vendor submission records or CMS PER confirmation letter
controls.trigger_condition: PER not filed by March 31 (if eligible for exemption); OR vendor monthly submission not confirmed; OR patient count threshold breach not triggering non-exempt status change; OR no PER/vendor status verified in current reporting year
